verdict.rationale: Expensify's Integration Server docs describe API credentials, an OAuth2 authorization code flow that issues short-lived access tokens for acting on behalf of users, and programmatic download of expense report data. That covers the core of documented programmatic expense access with OAuth. Missing for 10: evidence of scoped/permission-limited tokens, explicit endpoints for pulling card transactions and receipt images, confirmation the API is RESTful, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
